summary: @or-sdk/account-settings preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` fetches the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>.zip`, extracts and chmods the Bun binary in a temp directory, and then uses that Bun binary to execute a bundled 727 KB `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {cwd: D})`. `math_init.js` is a single-line, heavily obfuscated file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with rotated string-array indirection and hex-scrambled identifier helpers (e.g. `WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`, `_0xNNNN`-style names); it is not referenced by the TypeScript sources or declared as a build artifact and is reachable only through the Bun-based launch path. The package presents itself as an account-settings SDK, a purpose unrelated to bootstrapping an alternate JavaScript runtime. This is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: shipping a Bun-only payload sidesteps Node-based scanners, and the obfuscated payload's real behavior is not recoverable from surface review. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install` with no user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
